DIAGNOSIS READY: No significant finding.

The iron panel and upper endoscopy results are normal, which rules out iron deficiency anemia, bleeding ulcers, and many structural causes for your symptoms. Since your CBC, lactate, and initial metabolic panels were also normal, the combination of confusion, abdominal pain, and vomiting does not currently point to a life-threatening condition like sepsis, diabetic ketoacidosis, or gastrointestinal malignancy. Given the lack of objective abnormalities, further invasive testing is not indicated at this time.
